tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Use this when a person wants to book with a business on Bookatu and you need its details first. Give the business as its bookatu.com link or its own domain on Bookatu, or as its slug. Returns its city and area (never a street address), its time zone and the time there now, this week's opening hours,

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Use this when you know the business and the person wants to see what it offers. Returns each service's name, description, length and price, any deposit, and how it is booked: bookVia assistant means a time can be held here, and bookVia website means the person books on the business's own page at boo

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Use this when the person has chosen a service and wants to know when it can be done. Returns open times over up to 14 days, each on the business's clock and, when you pass clientTimeZone, on the person's clock too, with the price at that time. tools.name: hold_booking
tools.description: Use this when the person has picked a time from check_availability and said yes to its price and the cancellation policy. tools.name: confirm_booking
tools.description: Use this when the person reads you the 6-digit code from the email hold_booking sent them. Books the held time: the answer is confirmed, or requested when the business looks at new bookings before accepting them, with the booking's reference. If someone else took the time first, it offers up to thre

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Use this when the person asks whether a held time was confirmed, or where their booking stands now. Pass the holdId hold_booking returned. Returns the status (such as awaiting_client, confirmed, requested, declined, cancelled or moved), the business and service, and the start time. It returns no per

tools.name: release_hold
tools.description: Use this when the person no longer wants a time you held for them and has not confirmed it. Ends the hold at once, so the time is free again. Do not use for cancelling a confirmed booking: release_hold only ends a hold that is still waiting, and the person cancels a booking with the business.

tools.name: send_enquiry
tools.description: Use this when a person wants to ask a business on Bookatu about a trip or service, or ask it a question, instead of holding a time. Pass the person's own words as message, and people or dates only if they said them. Bookatu emails the person a 6-digit code and a link, and nothing reaches the busines

tools.name: confirm_enquiry
tools.description: Use this when the person has the 6-digit code from Bookatu's email about their enquiry and asks you to send it. The business replies to the person by email. Do not use for a held time: that is confirm_booking.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_business" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
